name: elite/SQLi UNION reflection exfiltration primitive
description: [critical] UNION-based exfiltration primitive: injected UNION SELECT appends a constant marker to the result set — marker in the response proves full data flow (any subsequent query value can be exfiltrated). Keywords: sqli union select exfiltration injection data. ctrl: benign request has no marker -> not falsified. probe_url = endpoint reflecting the q value into SQL results; default probes 2 columns (NULL,NULL,marker) — copy skill incrementing NULLs per column count. Chain: run time-based/error-based detection first, then this for impact.
